entries.description: Swiss-built back-office software for small businesses in Switzerland, the EU and the US. MCP tools cover clients, quotes, invoices, payments, expenses, documents, engagements, products, books and VAT exports in one workspace. Authenticate with a personal API token.
representativeQueries: Create and send a Swiss QR invoice
List my unpaid invoices and record a payment
Prepare the Swiss VAT return from my books
Add an expense or client to my business workspace
